details.name: Calculating the Average of Input Integers
details.description: Construct a program that reads a series of integers from the user, sums them up, and calculates their average. The user enters 0 to indicate the end of the input.

details.name: Calculating the Average of the Input Integers that are an Even Number
details.description: Construct a program that reads a series of integer values from the user, sums up the integers that are an even number, and calculate their average. The user enters 0 to indicate the end of the input.

details.name: Calculating the Average of Floating-Point Numbers
details.description: Construct a program that reads a series of non-negative floating-point numbers from the user, sums them up, and calculate their average.\nNote that you need to think what value should the program use to indicate the end of the input.
